verdict.rationale: A first-party managed Kubernetes service is a fair question for a cloud infrastructure provider, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a managed Kubernetes service, its upgrade policy, or cluster autoscaling. The CLI, SDK, Terraform, IAM, billing and free-tier items do not address this story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, Kubernetes is managed — a first-party managed K8s service with documented upgrade policy and autoscaling
